_about: Hand-written notes from the EADA codebooks (data/eada_codebook.csv), checked against the data for 2015-16..2024-25 on 2026-11-09. Merged into data/eada_mappings.json by build_eada.py; the Data Researcher reads them with read_mappings. Column descriptions here override the codebook label. Keys are bare column names. The tables are trimmed by sql/tables.sql; its header says what was left out and why.

gotchas.note: Revenue and expenses by team are only in sports (one row per sponsored sport). For a school's men's vs. women's spending, sum sports.expense_menall / expense_womenall, or use v_spending_by_gender. Team figures leave out money not assigned to any team (institutions.tot_expense_all_notalloc: facilities, administration...); grnd_total_expense = all team expenses + not allocated. Say which one a number is.

sports.partic_* and sum_partic_* count an athlete once per team, so summing them over sports counts multi-sport athletes several times (participation opportunities, not people). For people (proportionality, per-athlete spending) use institutions.undup_ct_partic_men / undup_ct_partic_women, as v_proportionality does.

Columns ending in _menall / _womenall, sum_partic_* and the unduplicated counts INCLUDE co-ed team members of that sex; partic_men / partic_women do not. Say whether a figure includes co-ed teams when it matters.

Use v_proportionality: female share of full-time undergraduates minus female share of (unduplicated) athletes, in percentage points. Positive = women underrepresented among athletes. Prong 1 of the three-part test only; it does not establish compliance or non-compliance.
efmalecount / effemalecount / eftotalcount are FULL-TIME UNDERGRADUATES (what EADA reports under 20 U.S.C. 1092(g)), not total enrollment. eftotalcount = efmalecount + effemalecount.
Names are official IPEDS names (e.g. 'The University of Alabama'). Resolve user wording through institution_aliases (ILIKE), then filter on unitid.

survey_year is the END of the academic year: 2025 = 2024-25. Loaded 2016-2025. 2021 (2020-21, COVID) has ~200 fewer schools; don't call a 2020-to-2021 drop a trend. The latest year predates revenue sharing (2025-26).
About 61% of school-years report total revenue exactly equal to expenses (institutional support fills the gap), so revenue minus expenses is not a measure of profit or of which teams 'make money'.

sports has only sponsored sports (rows with no participants were dropped at build time; the raw 2019-20 file listed unsponsored ones). A missing school+sport row = not sponsored. partic_men / partic_women are NULL when that sport has no team of that sex; money and coach columns are 0 instead. Count women's teams with partic_women IS NOT NULL.

Filter on sports after get_enum_values. Track and swimming are reported combined ('Track and Field and Cross Country (combined)', 'Swimming and Diving (combined)') or split, depending on the school: include both forms. 'Other Sports' lumps unlisted sports.
EADA has no conference column. classification_name gives the division (e.g. 'NCAA Division I-FBS'); some values have trailing spaces, so use TRIM or ILIKE.

sports has coach counts by team gender x coach sex (e.g. women_team_head_coaches_female), full- and part-time combined. Salaries are only per school, as averages: *_salary_* per coach, *_sal_fte_* per full-time equivalent (fairer when part-time coaches differ by team gender). num_hdcoach_* (per school) differs from the sum of sport-level head coaches in ~2% of school-years.

EADA records institutional athletics money. Third-party NIL deals never appear here, and revenue-sharing payments are not in the years loaded. Use nil_facts for NIL figures and say which money flow each number belongs to.

columns.unitid: IPEDS unit ID: a school's stable identifier across years. Filter and join on this.
columns.institution_name: Official IPEDS name of the school. Resolve user wording via institution_aliases; filter on unitid.
columns.survey_year: End year of the academic year the row covers: 2025 = 2024-25.
columns.classification_name: Athletic association and division, e.g. 'NCAA Division I-FBS', 'NCAA Division III with football', 'NJCAA Division I'.
columns.undup_ct_partic_men: Male athletes on men's and co-ed teams, each counted once.
columns.undup_ct_partic_women: Female athletes on women's and co-ed teams, each counted once.
columns.studentaid_men: Athletically related student aid to men's teams, USD.
columns.studentaid_women: Athletically related student aid to women's teams, USD.
columns.studentaid_coed: Athletically related student aid to co-ed teams, USD.
columns.studentaid_total: Athletically related student aid, all teams, USD.
columns.recruitexp_men: Recruiting expenses for men's teams, USD.
columns.recruitexp_women: Recruiting expenses for women's teams, USD.
columns.recruitexp_coed: Recruiting expenses for co-ed teams, USD.
columns.tot_revenue_all_notalloc: Athletics revenue not assigned to any team or sex, USD.
columns.tot_expense_all_notalloc: Athletics expenses not assigned to any team or sex (facilities, administration...), USD.
columns.grnd_total_revenue: All athletics revenue: every team + not allocated, USD.
columns.grnd_total_expense: All athletics expenses: every team + not allocated, USD.
columns.sports: Sport name, e.g. 'Basketball', 'Soccer'. Filter after get_enum_values.
columns.partic_men: Participants on the men's team (NULL if no men's team).
columns.partic_women: Participants on the women's team (NULL if no women's team).
columns.partic_coed_men: Men on the co-ed team in this sport.
columns.partic_coed_women: Women on the co-ed team in this sport.
columns.sum_partic_men: Men in this sport: men's team + co-ed team.
columns.sum_partic_women: Women in this sport: women's team + co-ed team.
columns.revenue_menall: Revenue of the men's team + co-ed men in this sport, USD.
columns.revenue_womenall: Revenue of the women's team + co-ed women in this sport, USD.
columns.total_revenue_all: All team revenue in this sport, USD.
columns.expense_menall: Expenses of the men's team + co-ed men in this sport, USD.
columns.expense_womenall: Expenses of the women's team + co-ed women in this sport, USD.
columns.total_expense_all: All team expenses in this sport, USD.
columns.opexp_menall: Game-day operating expenses of the men's team + co-ed men, USD. Part of expense_menall.
columns.opexp_womenall: Game-day operating expenses of the women's team + co-ed women, USD. Part of expense_womenall.
columns.total_opexp_all: Game-day operating expenses, all teams in this sport, USD.
columns.men_team_head_coaches_male: Male head coaches of the men's team (full- and part-time).
columns.men_team_head_coaches_female: Female head coaches of the men's team.
columns.women_team_head_coaches_male: Male head coaches of the women's team.
columns.women_team_head_coaches_female: Female head coaches of the women's team.
columns.coed_team_head_coaches_male: Male head coaches of the co-ed team.
columns.coed_team_head_coaches_female: Female head coaches of the co-ed team.
columns.men_team_asst_coaches_male: Male assistant coaches of the men's team.
columns.men_team_asst_coaches_female: Female assistant coaches of the men's team.
columns.women_team_asst_coaches_male: Male assistant coaches of the women's team.
columns.women_team_asst_coaches_female: Female assistant coaches of the women's team.
columns.coed_team_asst_coaches_male: Male assistant coaches of the co-ed team.
columns.coed_team_asst_coaches_female: Female assistant coaches of the co-ed team.
columns.alias: An alternate spelling of a school's name. Match user wording here with ILIKE, then use unitid.
columns.female_athletes: Female athletes, each counted once, incl. co-ed teams.
columns.total_athletes: Athletes, men + women, each counted once, incl. co-ed teams.
columns.female_undergrad_pct: Women's share of full-time undergraduates, percent.
columns.gap_pp: female_undergrad_pct minus female_athlete_pct, percentage points. Positive = women underrepresented among athletes.
columns.men_expenses: Men's team expenses incl. co-ed men, all sports, USD.
columns.women_expenses: Women's team expenses incl. co-ed women, all sports, USD.
columns.women_expense_pct: Women's share of team expenses (men + women), percent. Excludes unallocated expenses.
columns.men_expense_per_athlete: men_expenses / male athletes (each counted once), USD.
columns.women_expense_per_athlete: women_expenses / female athletes (each counted once), USD.
columns.unallocated_expenses: Expenses not assigned to any team, USD.
columns.grand_total_expenses: All athletics expenses: men's + women's team expenses + unallocated, USD.
columns.fact_id: Stable id of the figure, e.g. 'csc-2025-12-cleared-value'.
columns.report: The report or release the figure appears in.
columns.source_type: official_body, industry_report, policy_document, news or estimate.
columns.retrieved_via: 'primary' if read in the original report; otherwise where it was read.
columns.published: Publication date of the report (from the document itself).
columns.period_covered: The period the figure describes. Always state it with the number.
columns.sport: Sport the figure covers ('all' if not sport-specific).
columns.value_low: The figure, or the low end of a range.
columns.value_high: The figure, or the high end of a range (= value_low unless the source gives a range).
columns.unit: percent, USD millions, deals or athletes.
columns.method_note: How the source produced the figure and what it does NOT measure. Read before using the number.
columns.url: Where the figure can be checked.
columns.verified_against_primary: true once checked in the original report; false = seen only in secondary coverage, so say so.
